name: POST /api/AmcReportV2/DryRunSQL - SqlType=report_sql
description: 单接口测试：POST /api/AmcReportV2/DryRunSQL。SQL查询试运行(不落地执行,仅校验/预估；结果依赖具体SQL与实例schema)。场景：SqlType=report_sql。500条随机样本中占比约74.4%(372次)。

request_body.SqlQuery:
WITH purchasers AS (
  SELECT
    user_id
  FROM amazon_attributed_events_by_conversion_time
  WHERE
    conversions = 1
    AND conversion_event_category = 'purchase'
    AND (entity_id IN (1) AND campaign_id IN (1))
    AND tracked_item IN (1)
  GROUP BY user_id
),
brand_purchase_counts AS (
  SELECT
    c.user_id,
    SUM(c.conversions) AS brand_purchase_cnt,
    MAX(IF(c.new_to_brand, 1, 0)) AS is_ntb
  FROM conversions_with_relevance c
  INNER JOIN purchasers p
    ON c.user_id = p.user_id
  WHERE
    c.conversions = 1
    AND c.event_category = 'purchase'
    AND c.tracked_item IN (1)
  GROUP BY c.user_id
)
SELECT
  SUM(is_ntb) AS ntb_users,
  SUM(IF(brand_purchase_cnt = 1, 1, 0)) AS brand_buy_1_users,
  SUM(IF(brand_purchase_cnt = 2, 1, 0)) AS brand_buy_2_users,
  SUM(IF(brand_purchase_cnt = 3, 1, 0)) AS brand_buy_3_users,
  SUM(IF(brand_purchase_cnt = 4, 1, 0)) AS brand_buy_4_users,
  SUM(IF(brand_purchase_cnt = 5, 1, 0)) AS brand_buy_5_users,
  SUM(IF(brand_purchase_cnt = 6, 1, 0)) AS brand_buy_6_users,
  SUM(IF(brand_purchase_cnt >= 7, 1, 0)) AS brand_buy_7plus_users
FROM brand_purchase_counts

name: POST /api/AmcReportV2/DryRunSQL - SqlType=audience_sql
description: 单接口测试：POST /api/AmcReportV2/DryRunSQL。SQL查询试运行(不落地执行,仅校验/预估；结果依赖具体SQL与实例schema)。场景：SqlType=audience_sql。500条随机样本中占比约21.8%(109次)。

request_body.SqlQuery:
select count(1) from (WITH traffic AS (
  SELECT
    user_id,
    MAX(event_dt_utc) AS traffic_dt_max
  FROM
    sponsored_ads_traffic
  WHERE
    ad_product_type IN ('sponsored_brands', 'sponsored_products')
    AND (
      customer_search_term SIMILAR TO '(?i)keyword1'
      OR customer_search_term SIMILAR TO '(?i)keyword2'
      OR customer_search_term SIMILAR TO '(?i)keyword3'
    )
  GROUP BY
    user_id
),
conv AS (
  SELECT
    user_id,
    MAX(event_dt_utc) AS conv_dt_max
  FROM
    conversions
  WHERE
    event_subtype = 'order'
  GROUP BY
    user_id
)
SELECT
  t.user_id
FROM
  traffic t
  LEFT JOIN conv c ON c.user_id = t.user_id
WHERE
  t.traffic_dt_max > c.conv_dt_max
  OR c.conv_dt_max IS NULL) T

name: POST /api/AmcReportV2/DryRunSQL - 不传SqlType
description: 单接口测试：POST /api/AmcReportV2/DryRunSQL。SQL查询试运行(不落地执行,仅校验/预估；结果依赖具体SQL与实例schema)。场景：不传SqlType。500条随机样本中占比约3.8%(19次)。

request_body.SqlQuery:
select count(1) from (WITH base_purchasers AS (
    SELECT
        user_id,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', conversion_event_date) AS purchase_month,
        SUM(purchases) AS total_purchases
    FROM amazon_attributed_events_by_conversion_time
    WHERE conversion_event_category = 'purchase'
      AND entity_id IN (1)
      AND campaign_id IN (1)
    GROUP BY
        user_id,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', conversion_event_date)
),
monthly_flags AS (
    SELECT
        user_id,
        purchase_month,
        CASE WHEN total_purchases > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS purchased_flag
    FROM base_purchasers
),
churn_pairs AS (
    SELECT
        cur.user_id,
        cur.purchase_month AS active_month,
        nxt.purchase_month AS next_month,
        cur.purchased_flag AS active_month_purchased,
        COALESCE(nxt.purchased_flag, 0) AS next_month_purchased
    FROM monthly_flags cur
    LEFT JOIN monthly_flags nxt
        ON cur.user_id = nxt.user_id
        AND SECONDS_BETWEEN(cur.purchase_month, nxt.purchase_month) = 2678400
)
SELECT
    active_month,
    COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS churned_users
FROM churn_pairs
WHERE active_month_purchased = 1
  AND next_month_purchased = 0
GROUP BY
    active_month) T
